latest.notes:
Adds Delete and Trash to the library, and lets the assistant see file names.

• Right-click one or many selected carts in the Library for "Delete and Trash": the carts are removed AND their audio files go to the Finder Trash, where Put Back restores them if you change your mind. Admin accounts only.
• Anything playing, lined up next, or under a talk-over is left completely alone — both its cart and its file. A file that can't be trashed keeps its cart, and everything skipped is reported rather than removed quietly.
• The assistant can now see and search each element's audio file name, so asking it about duplicate imports — the ones ending "(2).mp3" — finds them.

Includes everything in v0.5.79: cover-version separation, Play Info on log rows, double-click to edit metadata, and the top-of-hour filler fix.
